brief_title: Glucagon-like Peptide-1 Levels, Insulin Resistance and Insulin Sensitivity Index in Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus
official_title: Comparative Study of Incretin System in Three Ethnic Groups With Abnormal Glucose Tolerance

primary_outcomes.measure: change in blood glucose load response to sitagliptin
primary_outcomes.time_frame: pre-treatment of sitagliptin and post 12-week treatment of sitagliptin

primary_outcomes.measure: change in blood insulin response to sitagliptin
primary_outcomes.time_frame: pre-treatment of sitagliptin and post 12-week treatment of sitagliptin

brief_summary: This study is conducted to examine GLP-1, insulin resistance and insulin sensitivity portfolio in Malay, Chinese and Indian populations in Malaysia and to study the effect of DPPIV inhibitor in T2DM patients with different GLP-levels.

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Subjects are newly diagnosed of T2DM according to World Health Organisation criteria) and do not receive any glucose-lowering drugs
* Subjects with normal glucose tolerance test according to World Health Organisation criteria which is carried out immediately before inclusion in the study
* Subjects who are willing to participate and sign the informed consent form

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients with pre-existing T2DM
* Patients with family history of diabetes
* Patients receiving glucose-lowering medications
* Patients with anemia, abnormal serum creatinine level, macroalbuminuria, proliferative retinopathy, impaired liver function
